startup_anchor.mask: default-reset startup cohort on flat, first1s; shared weights affect all terrains

actuator_guard.scope: all training environments since last log; 200 Hz, including resets

stair_speed.criterion: eligible forward exit > 4m without physical termination; not independent stair completion
stair_speed.statistics_mode: cumulative stochastic training episodes; no automatic speed-weight adjustment

terrain_allocation.evidence: matched training strata, not independent held-out validation

course.interpretation: independent exploration levels, not certified capability

pit.acceptance: all wheels supported on top, full collision body past edge, quiet/upright for 2s; phase_stance_v1 additionally requires nominal leg-angle bands and 0.46+/-0.10 m support-relative base height
pit.stop_protocol: external perfect-state stop command on platform; not autonomous student detection
pit.course_evidence: per-environment, per-speed training progression; not independent validation
pit.course_metric: full-body climb confirmed for 0.2s; body remains past edge and no physical failure or lane exit at episode end
pit.stable_metric_version: phase_stance_v1; compare interval deltas after profile switch
